sources.games: 569 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats, support position: under 2.5 last hits a minute), win 43.9%. Eul's, Glimmer Cape and Ghost Scepter rules rest on 61, 40 and 35 games; the Ghost Scepter one is thin (14 games with it). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py skywrath_mage.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Eul's Scepter of Divinity, Glimmer Cape, Ghost Scepter.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 101 (Ancient Seal, Mystic Flare), 44 (Phantom Assassin: Phantom Strike is a unit-targeted jump) and 71 (Spirit Breaker: Charge of Darkness is unit-targeted), 7.41f.

rules.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eul's Scepter of Divinity (2600 gold): Cyclone on yourself makes you invulnerable for 2.5 s, basic dispel, goes through spell immunity, 23 s cooldown, 550 cast range. Phantom Assassin's Phantom Strike and Spirit Breaker's Charge of Darkness are unit-targeted jumps (/herodata). Not in the usual build; high-rank Skywrath Mages against them buy it in 23% of 61 games (6% otherwise), won 64% against 23%.

reason.en: {enemy} jumps onto a hero with {spell}: {item} on yourself makes you invulnerable for 2.5 seconds and dispels some debuffs
reason.uk: {enemy} стрибає на героя через {spell}: {item} на себе робить вас невразливим на 2,5 секунди й знімає частину дебафів

rules.name: Glimmer Cape
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Glimmer Cape (2150 gold): after a 0.5 s delay invisibility, +20 movement speed and a 375 magic damage barrier for 5 s on you or an ally, 600 cast range, 15 s cooldown. Not in the usual build; against three or more magic damage heroes high-rank Skywrath Mages buy it in 38% of 40 games (12% otherwise), won 80% against 52%.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} puts a 375 magic damage barrier on you or an ally for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} дає вам або союзнику магічний бар'єр на 375 шкоди на 5 секунд

rules.name: Ghost Scepter
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Ghost Scepter (1500 gold): 4 s ghost form, immune to physical damage but unable to attack and more vulnerable to magic damage, 22 s cooldown. It is in his build (32% of the won games, ~25 min); against two or more physical carries it is 40% of 35 games (30% otherwise), won 57% against 24%.

reason.en: {enemy} and another physical carry are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, it makes you immune to physical damage for 4 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} та ще один фізичний керрі в їхній команді: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, він робить вас невразливим до фізичної шкоди на 4 секунди

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: null_talisman 84% (3), ward_dispenser 94% (4), magic_wand 50% (8), ring_of_basilius 60% (10), arcane_boots 59% (13), staff_of_wizardry 89% (18), great_famango 21% (18), vitality_booster 52% (20), rod_of_atos 45% (21), aghanims_shard 45% (24), kaya 47% (25), ghost 32% (25), blink 32% (28), point_booster 22% (28). Reviewed: dropped Null Talisman, Ring of Basilius, Great Famango, Vitality Booster, Staff of Wizardry and Point Booster (parts or small). STRATZ pos4: Rod of Atos 19 min (57%), the same first item. Ghost Scepter 32% of the won games.

skills.basis: 569 games since 7.41: maxed skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt > skywrath_mage_ancient_seal > skywrath_mage_concussive_shot 238 (win 54.2%), skywrath_mage_ancient_seal > skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt > skywrath_mage_concussive_shot 71 (win 57.7%), skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt > skywrath_mage_ancient_seal 56 (win 16.1%); talents 10: Arcane Bolt Cast Range 443/550 (46.3%), +1.5 Mana Regen 107/550 (42.1%); 15: Ancient Seal Cooldown 290/349 (58.6%), Concussive Shot Slow 59/349 (59.3%); 20: Ancient Seal Increased Magic Damage 69/123 (68.1%), Global Concussive Shot 54/123 (57.4%); 25: Mystic Flare Damage 15/21 (73.3%), Arcane Bolt Int Multiplier 6/21 (50.0%).

notes.basis: Valve 7.41f Ancient Seal: silences the target for 3/4/5/6 s and amplifies spell damage taken, 700-850 cast range, 14 s cooldown. The escape group (draft_analysis.ESCAPES) casts its escapes as spells, which a silence stops.

reason.en: {enemy} escapes with a spell: keep Ancient Seal for them, a silence stops them from casting it
reason.uk: {enemy} тікає за допомогою закляття: бережіть Ancient Seal для нього — тиша не дасть його застосувати
